name: Kanako Yasaka
requirementSummary: Defeat Sanae first. Lowest clear difficulty is your cap.
_design_notes: Kanako Yasaka: Goddess of Wind and Rain, head deity of the Moriya Shrine on Youkai Mountain.
Patterns draw from Mountain of Faith Stage 6: divine rings, onbashira column curtains, howling wind spirals.
Aesthetic: Red and Blue orbs (divine duality), Golden stars (shrine radiance), Divine Spirits (godly essence).
Spellcard 2 references 'Native God — Omiwatari that God Walked' from The Grimoire of Marisa.
Final card echoes 'Divine Virtues of Wind God' (MoF Lunatic), the hardest attack in the fight.

introDialog.speaker: BOSS
introDialog.text: You've climbed all the way to the summit of Youkai Mountain. I respect the effort.

introDialog.speaker: BOSS
introDialog.text: But faith alone won't save you here. Let's see if you can endure a god's divine wind.

reimu.speaker: BOSS
reimu.text: The Hakurei Shrine Maiden. Tell me — how has your faith been lately?

reimu.speaker: PLAYER
reimu.text: I'm not here for theology. The incidents on this mountain end today.

reimu.speaker: BOSS
reimu.text: Then let us see if the Hakurei god grants you more power than I.

marisa.speaker: BOSS
marisa.text: A human who reached the mountain summit by sheer stubbornness. Impressive.

marisa.speaker: PLAYER
marisa.text: Stubbornness and a really good broom, ze. Now show me this divine wind!

marisa.speaker: BOSS
marisa.text: Your broom will be no match for a storm that reshapes mountains.

sanae.speaker: BOSS
sanae.text: Sanae. Have you come to test the faith you carry in your heart?

sanae.speaker: PLAYER
sanae.text: Lady Kanako! I must prove my worth — please, don't hold back!

sanae.speaker: BOSS
sanae.text: Then I will give you the full measure of a god's blessing — and wrath.

sakuya.speaker: BOSS
sakuya.text: The Scarlet Mansion's head maid. An odd visitor for a mountain shrine.

sakuya.speaker: PLAYER
sakuya.text: The Mistress asked me to investigate the disturbances. I merely followed orders.

sakuya.speaker: BOSS
sakuya.text: Orders from a vampire, against a wind god. I almost admire the audacity.

reisen.speaker: BOSS
reisen.text: A moon rabbit, on Youkai Mountain? Did you take a wrong turn at the kappa's river?

reisen.speaker: PLAYER
reisen.text: I-I was just delivering medicine and got completely lost, I swear!

reisen.speaker: BOSS
reisen.text: Lost rabbits find their way by enduring the storm. Let's begin.

cirno.speaker: BOSS
cirno.text: An ice fairy at the mountain summit? The wind here can shatter ice, you know.

cirno.speaker: PLAYER
cirno.text: I'm the strongest! I can take any wind — even a god's!

cirno.speaker: BOSS
cirno.text: Then let the strongest withstand the divine gale.

victoryDialog: You withstood the wind and rain of a god. Take that faith with you when you descend.
defeatDialog: The mountain reclaims what it is owed. Rest here a while.

victoryDialogByCharacter.reimu: The Hakurei bloodline remains unbroken. I grant you passage through my domain — this time.
victoryDialogByCharacter.marisa: Your spark burned bright enough to scatter even my divine wind. I acknowledge it, ze.
victoryDialogByCharacter.sanae: You have surpassed your own god, Sanae. That is the finest miracle you have ever made.
victoryDialogByCharacter.sakuya: The maid stops even time and a divine gale. Report to your mistress: the mountain is stable.
victoryDialogByCharacter.reisen: The lost rabbit found her footing on the mountain. Perhaps the moon is not your only home.
victoryDialogByCharacter.cirno: Strongest indeed. The mountain air agrees with you, little ice fairy.

defeatDialogByCharacter.reimu: The Hakurei god could not lend you enough faith today. Try visiting the mountain shrine next time.
defeatDialogByCharacter.marisa: Not even your spark can outshine a storm that births lightning. Return when you're ready.
defeatDialogByCharacter.sanae: Faith is the beginning, Sanae — not the end. Come back when you've grown stronger.
defeatDialogByCharacter.sakuya: Precision falters before a wind with no fixed moment. Tell your mistress to look elsewhere.
defeatDialogByCharacter.reisen: The mountain is no place for a moon rabbit without her bearings. Find your way home.
defeatDialogByCharacter.cirno: Ice melts before the divine gale. Come back when the seasons have been kinder to you.

phases._note: Nonspell 1: Mountain Wind Awakening. Remilia-style double counter-rotating SPRINKLER curtains + occasional aimed volleys. patternTempo 200 makes the rotation loop fire almost every tick.

attacks._note: CCW rotating 3-arm BLUE_ORB_LARGE curtain — counter-spin creates diamond gaps
Fan-comb burst of GOLD every ~0.5s — aimed pressure fill

phases._note: Spell 1: Wind Sign 'Divine Wind from the Moriya Shrine'. Kanako's signature DIVINE_WIND C-curl pattern + fast RING_OFFSET background pressure + aimed GOLD.
phases.spellName: Wind Sign "Divine Wind from the Moriya Shrine"

attacks._note: DIVINE_WIND: Yasaka-scripted C-turn spiral. Builds layered rings then releases with angular curve.
Dense BLUE_ORB ring fires every tick — tightens gaps between DIVINE_WIND waves

phases._note: Nonspell 2: Sacred Mountain Rainfall. Remilia Nonspell-2-style dual SWEEP curtains from opposite directions + aimed GOLD pressure.

attacks._note: Red shrine shots sweep R→L — counter-direction cuts off retreat

phases._note: Spell 2: Native God 'Omiwatari that God Walked'. Remilia Spell-1-style LASER_ROTATING grid from center + dense RING_OFFSET every-tick fill.

attacks._note: Rotating laser grid — arm count and warn time scale with difficulty
Large blue orbs every tick — fill the space between laser spokes
Small red orbs every tick — faster, fills gaps left by large orbs

phases._note: Nonspell 3: Onbashira Pillar Storm. Intense dual counter-rotating SPRINKLER with comb fans while circling fast. Harder than nonspell 1.

attacks._note: 3-nozzle DIVINE_SPIRIT, each fires a 2-bullet fan — pillar of teal pairs

phases._note: Spell 3: Divine Virtue 'Virtue of Wind God'. Brutal rotating laser grid + DIVINE_WIND C-curls + two dense every-tick RING_OFFSET layers.

attacks._note: Wide rotating laser grid — lunatic has 32 spokes with only 8-tick warning
DIVINE_WIND between laser cycles — C-curl walls that force micro-dodging
Large red orbs every tick — no safe corner while dodging lasers
Blue orbs every tick offset from red — alternating layers block retreat
